shared.errorBody: The data did not load. Check that the local emulators are running, then try again.

worker.title: Mothers in your village
worker.incomingHint: Consent has been recorded for a mother moving here. Open her card to review, then accept.
worker.emptyBody: No mothers are registered in this village. Register the first one to open her journey card.

register.title: Register a mother
register.name: Name
register.hint: Only these details are stored. Nothing is interpreted or scored.
register.errorName: Please enter a name of at least 2 characters.
register.errorMonth: Please choose the expected delivery month.
register.errorSave: The mother could not be saved. Please try again.

journey.title: Journey card
journey.missingBody: This mother is not in the demo data. Go back and choose another.
journey.noAccessBody: This mother is not in your care. The sending worker records her consent first, and the receiving worker must accept before her card is opened to them.
journey.milestoneHint: Placeholder plan — the final milestone names and schedule come from the clinical lead.
journey.noCardBody: This mother has no journey card in the data.
journey.readonlyAcceptBody: You can read her summary now. Accept the handover to start adding visits to her card.
journey.handoverWaitingBody: {{name}} in {{village}} has been asked to accept her care.
journey.youCareBody: You are her current health worker. You can add visits and update milestones.
journey.readonlyHeadTitle: She is with another village now
journey.readonlyHeadBody: Her care was accepted by {{name}} in {{village}}. You can still see her card and activity.
journey.revokedBody: She withdrew consent and is back with {{village}}.
journey.keepHistory: Entries stay in this log. Nothing is deleted, and a correction keeps the earlier version.
journey.noVisitsBody: Visits you add appear here with who entered them and when.
journey.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
journey.noActivity: No consent or handover activity yet.

handover.title: Record consent to move
handover.workerPlaceholder: No health worker in this village
handover.explain1: Her name, home village and preferred language.
handover.explain2: Her journey card: the milestones recorded as done, the next dated milestone, and the visit log.
handover.explain3: Nothing else is shared. She can withdraw this consent at any time.
handover.wordingNote: Consent wording is a placeholder for review with the programme team.
handover.consentLabel: {{name}} has given her consent to share the details above.
handover.noConsentNote: Without her consent, no handover is created and no data is shared.
handover.errorConsent: Tick the consent box to continue.
handover.errorSave: The handover could not be recorded. Please try again.
handover.alreadyTitle: A handover is already in progress
handover.alreadyBody: There is already a pending or accepted handover for this mother.

mother.title: My visits
mother.readonly: This screen is for viewing only. Only you can withdraw your consent.
mother.withdrawConfirmBody: Your details will no longer be shared with {{village}}. Your own health worker keeps your record.
mother.withdrawnBody: Your record is only with {{village}} now.
mother.withdrawError: Could not withdraw consent. Please try again.
mother.noCardBody: Your health worker will add visits here.

messages.motherIntro: [PLACEHOLDER] These are the visits recorded for you. Your health team's message will appear here.
messages.motherNextEmpty: [PLACEHOLDER] No next visit date is recorded yet.

safety.assistive: Assistive only — stores, shares with consent, notifies and reminds. It never diagnoses, scores risk or advises treatment.
safety.content: Care-plan text is pre-written and clinician-approved.
